title: First LLM call
scope: One OpenAI-compatible model call with system/user roles, a deadline, safe API failure output and provider usage. No tools, retrieval, routing, authentication or storefront.
status: Verified — independent UI, tests and packaging

title: Prompt design
scope: The integrated application’s existing system prompt and its documented design decisions. No standalone prompt comparison experiment exists in ai-commerce.

title: Structured outputs
scope: Proposed conversion of model output into a validated shopping-requirements DTO. No structured model-output implementation was found. Tool-argument schemas and ordinary request DTOs are different boundaries.

title: Conversation state
scope: Caller-carried user/assistant history converted into Spring AI messages. Every request supplies its own state; there is no server-side memory or session store.
status: Verified — independent UI, tests and packaging

title: Streaming
scope: Proposed incremental answer delivery and cancellation. The active frontend awaits a complete JSON reply; no runnable streaming implementation was found.

title: Evaluation baseline
scope: The existing manual product-search cases and original descriptions of contract tests. No executable generated-answer evaluation baseline exists in ai-commerce. Retrieval evaluation is extracted in module 10.

title: First tool call
scope: One native search_products request, strict arguments, a commerce HTTP lookup and one final answer. Only search_products is exposed; batches larger than one are rejected.
status: Verified — independent UI, tests and packaging

title: Bounded tool orchestration
scope: Up to four read-only commerce calls, whole-batch validation before execution, call-ID preservation and one final model call without tools. No RAG or autonomous agent loop.
status: Verified — independent UI, tests and packaging

title: Tool authorization and safety
scope: JWT validation and permission enforcement in the AI API; forwarded bearer credentials and response projection; an independently runnable H2 order backend copied from commerce with customer ownership enforced behind HTTP. No browser identity journey.
status: Verified — independent UI, tests and packaging

title: Embeddings and semantic retrieval
scope: Local ONNX embeddings, safe Markdown preparation, cosine ranking and source/section retrieval metrics in memory. The source has no lexical-search comparison experiment, so that proposed portion remains missing.
status: Partially extracted — UI and unit checks verified

title: RAG ingestion
scope: Safe Markdown/catalog preparation, token-aware chunks, metadata, fingerprints and transactional PostgreSQL/pgvector replacement. No generation endpoint or LLM client is included.
status: Extracted — UI/unit checks verified; RAG integration pending

title: Grounded RAG answers
scope: Native knowledge-tool selection, evidence budgets, live public product checks, final generation and citation membership checks. Module 12 does not expose Learning-mode traces; no generated-answer quality score is claimed.
status: Extracted — UI/unit checks verified; RAG integration pending

title: Execution visibility
scope: Request-local safe execution events, completion ordering, durations and token counts; an isolated React trace viewer copied from the storefront. Cost estimation was not implemented in the source.
status: Partially extracted — UI and unit checks verified

title: Provider comparison
scope: Explicit provider aliases, isolated protocol adapters and fixture tests of model/options/credential boundaries. The source has no same-dataset comparison experiment or measured quality/cost table.
status: Partially extracted — UI and unit checks verified

title: Deterministic model routing
scope: Proposed deterministic routing by logical tiers with a strongest-model baseline. No implemented router was found; configured provider aliases are explicit selection, not routing.

title: Context and cost optimization
scope: The existing browser history window and character bounds, preserved as source reference. No measured context or cost optimization experiment exists in ai-commerce. Conversation handling is runnable in module 04.
